entries.title: I Corinthians 10:1
segments: For I would not, brethren, have you ignorant, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:2
segments: and were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:3
segments: and did all eat the same spiritual food;

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:4
segments: and did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them: and the rock was Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:5
segments: Howbeit with most of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:6
segments: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:7
segments: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:8
segments: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:9
segments: Neither let us make trial of the Lord, as some of them made trial, and perished by the serpents.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:10
segments: Neither murmur ye, as some of them murmured, and perished by the destroyer.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:11
segments: Now these things happened unto them by way of example; and they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages are come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:12
segments: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:13
segments: There hath no temptation taken you but such as man can bear: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation make also the way of escape, that ye may be able to endure it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:14
segments: Wherefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:15
segments: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:16
segments: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not a communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a communion of the body of Christ?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:17
segments: seeing that we, who are many, are one bread, one body: for we are all partake of the one bread.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:18
segments: Behold Israel after the flesh: have not they that eat the sacrifices communion with the altar?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:19
segments: What say I then? that a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:20
segments: But [I say], that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have communion with demons.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:21
segments: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of demons: ye cannot partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:22
segments: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:23
segments: All things are lawful; but not all things are expedient. All things are lawful; but not all things edify.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:24
segments: Let no man seek his own, but [each] his neighbor's [good].

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:25
segments: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, eat, asking no question for conscience' sake,

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:26
segments: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:27
segments: If one of them that believe not biddeth you [to a feast], and ye are disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience' sake.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:28
segments: But if any man say unto you, This hath been offered in sacrifice, eat not, for his sake that showed it, and for conscience sake:

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:29
segments: conscience, I say, not thine own, but the other's; for why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:30
segments: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:31
segments: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:32
segments: Give no occasions of stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the church of God:

entries.title: I Corinthians 10:33
segments: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the [profit] of the many, that they may be saved.
